description: AI assistant powered by a trusted cultural knowledge base. Provides traceable retrieval and creative assistance across world heritage sites, museum collections, oracle bone characters, and academic literature. Covers heritage nomination texts, archaeological data, ceramic genome databases, pattern libraries, and more.
